notes.title: Update 5.5.0: New Notifications System, Tribute Visuals Updated and more
notes.notes: [h1]This update brings new tools and refinements to your journey through Mission 1[/h1][p][/p][h2]List of Updates 5.5.0 Brings:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Notifications System[/b] - The first iteration is here to keep you on top of resources, Sinners, and events in your domain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tribute Visuals[/b] - Brand new look to the Tribute objective panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Souls Movement[/b] - Refining the movement of the Souls to consume less processing and improve game performance through the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Additional Improvements[/b] - General fixes and inconsistencies fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Share Your Feedback[/h2][p]Join the discussion on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3733920/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/j79qjsSJBQ"]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.[/p]

notes.title: Tutorial Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
[p]We know it’s been a while since our last update, and you might be wondering what we’ve been working on behind the scenes. Well… we’ve been quietly brewing something important.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to finally share that the [b]Tutorial[/b] is on the way, and you’ll be able to play it [b]very soon[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]No more [i]“Why why why?”[/i] or [i]“How how how?”[/i][/p][p]
We’ve built a brand-new guided experience that walks you through the core mechanics, helping you get a much better grip on how to survive and thrive in [b]The HELL[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning, we’re getting closer to our next big milestone, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/011da4146d08bb34ca9846a7c0b2c21c2d2b02fc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/ec04f2915a318b5c6281b345166de91a70793ae2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/e8bc4a6d21622a09820cd636e7d6391ae603b092.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/8c22d28d097abe18f7349e8732337acb31271e3d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/6c705259c4a171cb767e12662922025c34648d58.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646045/620b69f9a03832b6bd1ea63ae9421349bab1b883.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned![/p]
